name: Sand Storm
doc: Sand Storm (Fastitocalon's attack): the root and the director - the sand funnel (its waving vertices, its path from the caster to the targets), the two dust pools, the wind sound; the damage. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag155_sand_storm.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pools, funnel vertices and packet arenas in the module).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Director
parts.doc: The sand funnel (its waving vertices, its path from the caster to the targets), the two dust pools, the wind sound; the damage

params.label: Damage tick
params.doc: The damage at this tick of the director
